observation.command: cd /workspace && grep -iE "error|failed" /tmp/dev.log | head; echo "---pages---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/stadt-klima; PID=$(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep :3000 | grep -oP 'pid=\K[0-9]+' | head -1); echo "pid=$PID"; [ -n "$PID" ] && kill $PID; sleep 2; echo stopped
